This document outlines the 
 maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every three years base as indicated by 
 Y3 in the title block.
The technical Specification of the MHY hydro unit:

Francis Turbine, maximum power: 180 mw, maximum 
 head 75 m, speed: 100 rpm, Woodward governor.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
 Abd Allah Esmaiel, tested by eng. Atef Sadek Sayed, accepted by eng. Ahmed 
 Saber Gabr: general director at High Dam Power Station, 
 approved by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Ahmed: High Dam Hydraulic Power Station head 
 sector and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman: HPGC quality general director & MPIS 
 coordinator

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable ID safety category.

Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the personal protective 
 equipment must used as safety shoes, safety helmet ...etc

Completely empty the tunnel 
 and the draft tube.

Secure closing intake and 
 draft tubes maintenance gates
Open the wicket gates to 100%
Switch off F403 automatic.
Close the main oil valve no.7.

Switch off the power supply of 
 MHY oil pumps.

Release pressure of the oil 
 pressure unit (MHY) to zero.
Using overhead crane 400 ton.
Using lightening 36 V.
Using 8 bar service air.
Use suitable warning boards.

Set of common and special 
wrenches.

Spare parts, gaskets and 
 rubber.

Benzene, Kerosene and cleaning 
 material (rag, cloth).
Packing and grease.

3 Portable lamps 36 V with 
 cable 30m.
Turbine oil.

Hydraulic cylinders (jack) 
 with deferent loads and hydraulic pumps.
Using 8 bar service air.
Use suitable warning boards.
Rubber and klingride gasket.
Fine grinding paper.
Piston ring
Gland packing
Grease and lubricant
Scrapers
Fine grinding paper
Rubber cord 8
Qualitative wiping material
Watch-type indicator

Device for checking the pump 
 centering
Set of different size bolts.
Stop watch
Wood ladder

Measure time of pressure drop for 1 atm in MHY 
 when the hydro-unit is stopped for the reserve

Determine values of oil losses from MHY vessel 
 which is performed by measured the pressure drop and oil level drop in MHY 
 vessel.

Determine the values of air losses from MHY 
 vessel (for performing the oil and air losses from MHY vessel it is necessary 
 completely closed all valves connected to MHY vessel during time test.
Determine oil pump capacity.

Check the function of relief valve of MHY oil 
 pump.

Check the function of unloader valve of MHY oil 
 pump.
Check noise and vibration of MHY oil pumps.

Basing on results of measurements, the decision 
 about the revision of MHY elements.

Make the system pressureless and drain the oil 
 from MHY vessel , oil return tank, servomotors and pipe lines of regulating 
 system into the oil facilities.

Check and clean the elements of pressure relay 
 block and replace the filters.
Check and clean oil measuring glass

Check the oil valves and replace the seals if 
 necessary.

Dismantle the air valves and change the packing 
 and testing pressure is to be performed.

Unloading, safety, non-return valve of MHY oil 
 pump is disassembled only if some defect had been discovered while testing the 
 pump.

Dismantle the coupling of MHY pump if the 
 electric motor is replaced and after that check up the oil pump centering.

Clean the filter of return tank by blowing out 
 dust with compressed air (8 bar).

Oil vessel and return tank (oil reservoir) 
 shall also clean and free of scale, rust, oil, grease, and other foreign 
 material.

Change the gasket of vessel hatch and close the 
 vessel and oil return tank hatches.

Fill in the vessel and drain tank with pure oil 
 taking into account the filling with oils the servomotors and pipelines of 
 regulating system.

Dismantle and take the covers and cylinders out 
 of housing of servomotor housing.

Inspect ,clean and grind the inside surface of 
 cylinders

Absence of corrosion, notches, dents and other 
 defects on surface of servomotor rod, discovered roughness should be smoothed 
 out.
If necessary, replace the piston rings.

Dismantle and replace gland packing, copper 
 sealing of air vent plug and o ring sealing cylinder.

Check and clean slide block, adjusting bush and 
 spacer.

Check and revise the mechanism of stopper and 
 indicators of stoppers positions.
Eliminate all detected oil leakages.

Test all the connection, which were 
 disassembled while revision and also check up the reliability of fastening of 
 all pipelines to the supports.

Check the needle valves of draining the 
 pressure-draft pipe lines.
Drain oil and clean the tank and filter

Check the float type arrangement together with 
 E.T.L

Check the valve no.249, 250, 251of leakage 
 pump.

If necessary, check up the
 motor-oil pump centering.
